cohort: The study included 87,736 women (43,868 ART and 43,868 non-ART pregnancies after propensity score matching) from a 2014-2015 birth cohort in the United States.
finding: Pregnancies with ART had an almost five-fold increased risk of unplanned peripartum hysterectomy compared to non-ART pregnancies, with 1.7 more hysterectomies per 1000 deliveries, although the absolute risks remained low.
